title: Nexus CreateCharacterRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/daemon/characters. The daemon resolves the active Creator; clients never send owner_creator_id. Requires an owned world_id for the atomic initial binding.

display_name.description: Character display name. Trimmed non-empty; at most 120 Unicode scalars. Untrimmed values are rejected.

world_id.description: Owned World for the initial active ActorWorldBinding.

image_uri.description: Optional Character-owned image URI (at most 2048 bytes).

persona.description: Optional persona metadata object. Serialized JSON at most 16384 bytes.

world_sheet_entry_id.description: Optional WorldSheet link on the initial binding (at most 128 bytes).
